en.headline: Greater Bay Area Science Forum opens this weekend with Nobel winners
en.dek: The three-day event, co-hosted by the governments of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau, will feature four Nobel laureates and parallel activities in Hong Kong and other cities.
body: The 2026 Greater Bay Area Science Forum will open on Saturday and run through Monday, co-hosted by the governments of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau, according to announcements at a news conference this week.

Organisers said the programme includes an opening ceremony and main forum in Nansha, Guangzhou, on Sunday, plus 15 professional sub-forums and 10 special activities across Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Huizhou, Dongguan and Yangjiang. Four Nobel laureates are expected to attend, including the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine winner for a keynote address.

The forum focuses on future industries and frontier technologies such as artificial intelligence and life sciences. It also plans to release a report on disruptive technology outlook for 2026 and host industry-academia matching sessions involving universities from Hong Kong and Macau.

zh.headline: 大灣區科學論壇本周末開幕 邀諾獎得主出席
zh.dek: 由粵港澳三地政府合辦的三日論壇將於周六起舉行，包括四位諾貝爾獎得主參與，並在香港等地設有平行活動。
body: 根據本周新聞發布會公布，2026大灣區科學論壇將於周六至周一舉行，由廣東省政府、香港特區政府及澳門特區政府共同主辦。
主辦方表示，論壇設有在廣州南沙舉行的開幕式及主論壇，以及15場專業分論壇和10場特色活動，活動地點涵蓋香港、深圳、惠州、東莞及陽江。預計有四位諾貝爾獎得主出席，包括2026年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎得主作主旨演講。
論壇聚焦未來產業及前沿科技，如人工智能及生命科學。主辦方亦計劃發布《顛覆性技術前瞻2026》報告，並舉辦涉及港澳高校的產學研對接活動。
